records.source: You can access Marnie's shop when she's not around.
records.translation: Maaari mong gamitin ang tindahan ni Marnie kahit wala siya.

records.source: You will fetch a better price when selling artifacts.
records.translation: Makakukuha ka ng mas mataas na halaga sa pagbebenta ng mga artepakto.

records.source: Bombs deal 25% less damage to you.
records.translation: Binabawasan ng 25% ang pinsalang idinudulot sa iyo ng mga Bomba.
Ang Sining ng Paghuli ng Alimango

records.source: Crab pots have a 25% chance to yield double.
records.translation: May 25% tsansang magbigay ng doble ang mga Bitag na Pang-alimango.

records.source: Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thick
records.translation: Jack na Maliksi, Jack na Matibay

records.source: All stones have a chance to drop a diamond when mined by hand.
records.translation: May tsansang maglaglag ng diyamante ang lahat ng bato kapag minina gamit ang kamay.

records.source: You become friends with people a little faster.
records.translation: Bahagya kang mas mabilis makipagkaibigan sa mga tao.
Pagmamapa ng mga Sistema ng Yungib

records.source: You get a 50% discount on Marlon's item retrieval service.
records.translation: Makakukuha ka ng 50% diskuwento sa serbisyo ni Marlon sa pagbawi ng mga bagay.

records.source: You have a slightly greater chance to find Mystery Boxes.
records.translation: Bahagyang mas mataas ang tsansa mong makahanap ng mga Kahong Misteryo.

records.source: You can now see the value of your items.
records.translation: Makikita mo na ngayon ang halaga ng iyong mga bagay.

records.source: Learn any Queen Of Sauce recipes that you don't already know.
records.translation: Matutuhan ang lahat ng resipe ng Reyna ng Sarsa na hindi mo pa alam.

records.source: You gain a little extra speed when riding a horse.
records.translation: Bahagyang tumataas ang iyong bilis kapag nakasakay sa kabayo.

records.source: Fishing treasure chests have a chance to yield roe.
records.translation: May tsansang maglaman ng Itlog ng Isda ang mga kabang-yaman sa pangingisda.

records.source: You run a little bit faster.
You run a little bit faster.
You have a greater chance to find items in the trash.
records.translation: Mas mataas ang tsansa mong makahanap ng mga bagay sa basura.

records.source: Monsters have a small chance to drop double loot.
records.translation: May maliit na tsansang maglaglag ng dobleng samsam ang mga halimaw.

records.source: Weeds have a greater chance to yield mixed seeds.
records.translation: Mas mataas ang tsansang magbigay ng Halo-halong Binhi ang mga damong ligaw.

records.source: Felled trees have a 5% chance to yield double the wood.
records.translation: May 5% tsansang magbigay ng dobleng kahoy ang mga pinutol na puno.
